classification_rules: Reuse stable canonical Syracuse target IDs.
Treat the January 27 City presentation as primary procurement/governance evidence, not as the signed/executed MSA.
Treat later council-vote reporting as corroboration of approval, not as a substitute for the executed contract.
Keep Flock and Axon as separate network eras.
Do not infer final reader deployment, technical control configuration, or Flock-to-Axon migration without native evidence.

findings.finding: An official City presentation establishes the proposal-stage Axon procurement terms for 26 readers, including term, cost ceiling, first-year-free structure, installation/maintenance scope, and RFP waiver.
The presentation itself records a pre-vote governance state; later independent reporting says Common Council approved the contract 7-1 on February 9.
The executed/signed MSA is still missing, so the canonical Axon-contract target remains unresolved.
No final inventory, native technical configuration, or Flock-to-Axon migration was established.
